factions.name: Kanemura Folk
factions.desc: Bell-town people: smiths, shopkeepers, priests. They fear the night now the bell is silent.

factions.name: Forest Folk
factions.desc: Charcoal burners and kodama keepers of Sugi no Mori. Wary of outsiders, loyal once trusted.

factions.name: River People
factions.desc: Fishers and ferry folk of Kawa Gorge and Taki Pool. Superstitious, generous, proud.

npcs.name: Priest Sōen

persona.personality: calm, old, guilt-ridden, speaks in careful half-truths
persona.secret: His order has known for centuries the bell holds Yamata no Orochi asleep. He never told the village.

npcs.greeting: Kanemori. The bell chose you the night it broke. I am sorry for that.

bell: Eight shards, eight voices. The bell was never silent before.
Bring them home, and I will recast it with Genzō.
orochi: Some names should not be spoken under this roof.
...Not yet. Ask me again when you carry three shards.
forest: The Lady of the Canopy took the first shard. She was never a lady.
fear: Since the bell cracked, the dead sleep badly.

npcs.name: Old Genzō

persona.personality: gruff, honest, secretly sentimental, judges people by their hands
fears: his hands shaking too much to cast again
persona.speech: grunts, short blunt sentences, calls Ren 'boy'
persona.secret: He cast the crack into the bell himself, forty years ago, by mistake, and has lied about it ever since.

npcs.greeting: Hm. Show me your hands. ...Calluses. Good. You'll do.

bell: Bronze remembers. Every crack is a story it can't stop telling.
forge: Bring iron, I'll make you a blade. Bring tamahagane, I'll make you a legend.
fear: Night's louder every week. Sleep with your sword, boy.

npcs.name: Hana

persona.personality: patient, sharp-tongued, curious, hides worry behind jokes
wants: a cure for her brother Sota's fever
persona.secret: She sold Jorōgumo silk to a hooded stranger for medicine money. The stranger was the Pilgrim of Ash.

npcs.greeting: Bleeding? Poisoned? Or just lost? I charge for two of those.

herbs: Green herb heals, red root warms, the blue cap kills. Mostly.
brother: Sota's fever won't break. Normal herbs don't touch it.
forest: Don't eat anything that glows. Learned that one the hard way.
trade: Salves, tea, tonics. Fair prices for a hero. Unfair for everyone else.
bye: Don't die. It's bad for business.

npcs.name: Mio

persona.personality: warm, gossipy, shrewd, knows everyone's business
persona.secret: She keeps a ledger of every villager's debts and secrets, just in case.

npcs.greeting: Little bell! Sit, eat. Then tell me everything.

rumor: They say a woman with a wooden mask walks the deep grove at night. Bring her something sweet.
Old Genzō hasn't slept well since the bell broke. Guilt, if you ask me.
Behind the falls there's singing. Fishermen won't go near.
food: Miso stew warms the bones. Rain's coming, eat.
trade: Rooms are cheap. Gossip is free. Stew is not.
bye: Come back alive, I hate rewriting the ledger.

persona.personality: quiet, gentle with animals, awkward with people
persona.speech: few words, talks to horses more than people
persona.secret: He once saw Jorōgumo as a beautiful woman and followed her into the trees. He came back three days later with no memory.

horse: Kaze's fast but scared of thunder. Mochi's slow, never scared of anything.
cart: A cart doubles what you carry to Takimura. Merchants pay well for that.
trade: Horse is four hundred. Horse and cart, nine. Treat them well, I'll know.
fear: Wolves took two foals last moon. Packs are bolder now.

npcs.name: Kaito

persona.personality: boastful, brave, jealous of Ren, wants glory badly
persona.secret: The Pilgrim of Ash has promised him the power of a shard if he steals one from Ren.

npcs.greeting: So you're the 'bell-keeper'. Funny. Nobody asked me.

duel: Spar with me. Wooden swords. Unless you're scared.
bell: Why you? I've guarded this frame for six years.
raid: You hunting the spider? I'm coming. Try and stop me.
fear: I'm not afraid of the night. I'm just... careful.

npcs.name: Ryū

persona.personality: proud, tactical, respects strength and silence
persona.secret: His old partner Jin didn't die in a hunt. He walked into the forest to follow the Masked Hermit and never came back.

npcs.greeting: You walk loud. We'll fix that.

hunt: Packs follow the alpha. Kill it, scare it, and the rest scatter.
Beaters drive, archers wait downwind, spears hold. Simple.
raid: The spider? With five good spears and fire arrows, yes. Alone, you're food.

npcs.name: Suzu

persona.speech: excited, many questions, calls Ren 'big bell'
persona.secret: She has already found the sealed cave mouth and heard something breathing inside.

npcs.greeting: You're going up the mountain? Take me! I know every path. Well. Most paths.

map: I'm mapping everything! There's a waterfall nobody's been behind.
summit: One day I'll stand on top and see the sea from the snow.
cave: The sealed cave breathes. In, out. Like it's asleep.
bye: Don't go anywhere cool without me!

npcs.name: Grandma Ume

persona.personality: tiny, ancient, terrifyingly direct, knows every fish and every legend
wants: the Golden Koi seen once more before she dies
persona.secret: She knew the Koi Priestess when they were both girls. One of them went behind the waterfall and never aged.

npcs.greeting: Skinny. Eat fish. Then we talk.

fish: Ayu in clear water, eel in rain. The Golden Koi only in the pool below the falls, and only for the patient.
koi: When the koi climbs the falls it becomes a dragon. Everyone knows that. Nobody believes it.
trade: I buy fish, I sell fish. Simple life. Good life.

npcs.name: Tetsu

persona.personality: charming, greedy, surprisingly loyal to partners
wants: a business partner with a cart
persona.speech: salesman patter, calls Ren 'partner' after trust 30
persona.secret: He smuggles monster parts to collectors in the lowlands.

npcs.greeting: A customer! Or, dare I hope, an investor?

trade: Buy low in Takimura, sell high in Kanemura. That's the whole secret. Don't tell anyone.
invest: Fund my stall, I give you a cut every dawn. Honest. Mostly.
rumor: Silk from the spider sells for a fortune down the mountain. Just saying.

npcs.name: Kiku

persona.speech: whispers in the forest, normal voice outside it
persona.secret: She feeds the kodama, and they tell her where Jorōgumo sleeps.

npcs.greeting: Shh. The little ones are watching. Be gentle here.

kodama: Kodama aren't enemies. Hit one and the forest remembers.
Leave sap at a stump at dusk. They'll bring you something back.
web: She sleeps in the high web when the mist is thick. Fire wakes her angry.
